This Diwali, enjoy "Titliaan" in 8K. Featuring Harrdy Sandhu and Sargun Mehta, with vocals by Afsana Khan, lyrics and composition by Jaani, and music by Avvy Sra.
Wishing you and your loved ones a Happy Diwali from Desi Melodies.

Director: Arvvindr S Khaira
